steps.title: Analyze Build Error Log
steps.description: Identified the `class, interface, or enum expected` compilation error in `MainActivity.java` as the primary cause of the build failure, indicating extraneous code outside the class definition.

steps.title: Clean MainActivity.java
steps.description: Removed the non-Java log lines and JSON block that were erroneously present at the end of `MainActivity.java`, causing the compilation error.

steps.title: Review Gradle Dependencies
steps.description: Checked the `app/build.gradle` file for any external or unauthorized dependencies that violate project rules.

steps.title: Remove Unauthorized Dependency
steps.description: Removed the `org.nanohttpd:nanohttpd` external library dependency from `app/build.gradle` as it is not permitted by project restrictions.

steps.title: Update App Build Gradle Plugin Syntax
steps.description: Migrated `app/build.gradle` from `apply plugin` to the modern `plugins { id 'com.android.application' }` syntax for Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2 compatibility.

steps.title: Confirm Existing Sound Removal
steps.description: Verified that all sound-related code, including `MediaPlayer` instantiation, `playSoundEffect` method, and calls to play sound effects, has already been removed from `MainActivity.java`.

steps.title: Confirm Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Confirmed that `AndroidManifest.xml` is correctly defined with the proper namespace and that the deprecated `package` attribute has already been removed, with `namespace` correctly declared in `app/build.gradle`.

steps.title: Validate UI Layouts
steps.description: Ensured the UI layouts `activity_main.xml` and `dialog_add_edit_note.xml` are structurally sound and correctly define the user interface elements.

steps.title: Verify Note Data Model Integrity
steps.description: Checked the `Note.java` class to ensure the data model, including ID, title, content, category, and JSON serialization/deserialization methods, is correct.

steps.title: Review Asynchronous Task Implementation
steps.description: Ensured `LoadNotesTask` (an `AsyncTask`) correctly handles background data loading, displays the `ProgressBar`, and updates the UI on completion.

steps.title: Validate Data Persistence Logic
steps.description: Confirmed that the `saveNotes` method correctly uses `SharedPreferences` to persist notes and that notes are loaded upon app startup.

steps.title: Check User Interaction Handlers
steps.description: Verified that all user interaction points, such as the 'Add Note' button, search `EditText` `TextWatcher`, `ListView` context menu, and options menu, are correctly implemented.

steps.title: Ensure Sorting and Filtering Functionality
steps.description: Reviewed the `sortNotes` and `applyFilterAndSearch` methods to ensure notes are consistently sorted and filtered based on user input and category selection.

steps.title: Final Code Compliance Check
steps.description: Performed a final check of all Java code for compliance with Java 8 standards (no lambdas/streams) and overall adherence to project guidelines.

steps.title: Building Category Notes
steps.description: Compiling and packaging the Android application after applying all necessary fixes.
